title: State Charge on a Fee Charged Again: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44)
content:
**Clause.** A re-charge state charge is added to a fee charged again under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), which is the fee charged on a filing whose fee charges were all reversed in full as charged in error. It follows the state group of the backing term's own state: the garaging state of an Owner Auto Policy term, or the resident state of a Named Non-Owner Policy term.

- **Florida or Virginia:** 6.00.
- **Texas or Georgia:** 3.00.
- **Arizona or Ohio:** no re-charge state charge.

**Basis Q&A.**

- *Does the filing state decide this charge?* No. The backing term's own state decides it.
- *An Owner Auto Policy term garaged in Georgia:* 3.00.
